messages:
Maria (CS): quick heads-up — during today's smoke load we hit a reserve gap for Nimbus' Dedicated pool. latency spikes at ~60 rps, 95th jumped 2.2x. need a fallback playbook before monday renewal call.
Sam (Infra): noted. looks like autoscale policy didn't spin up extra slots fast enough. existing policy: min=2, max=8, scale-step=1/30s. suggestion: temporary bump max to 12 + faster scale step for the next smoke.
Lee (Eng): can we do a targeted priming run that exercises KV warmup? most of the spike is cold-KV misses. also will enable prefix cache for convo-starts.
Anita (SE): I'll own the customer comms and renewal signal. low confidence until we show a successful fallthrough test. can we schedule a joint dry-run with Nimbus ops tomorrow?
Sam (Infra): action items: 1) Sam — edit autoscale policy and queue reserved slot guard (ETA 30m). 2) Lee — run targeted priming test and capture perf artifacts (ETA 1h). 3) Maria/Anita — capture renewal note and mitigation timeline (ETA end of day).
DeployBot: run/1754012360 loadtest-started user=nimbus-team profile=convo-heavy rps=70 duration=10m
Lee (Eng): running loadtest now. command I used: `./tools/loadtest --profile convo-heavy --rps 70 --duration 600 --target dedicated://nimbus/poolA`
Lee (Eng): hitting the same bump initially but KV priming reduced the 95th by ~35% after ~90s. attaching perf snapshot in the run artifacts.
Sam (Infra): Autoscale tweak pushed (max=12, scale-step=1/10s). also created a safeguard slot: `reserve_slot --pool poolA --count 2 --ttl 4h` in case of another surge.
Maria (CS): great. Anita — can you propose the renewal talking points: what we did, the safeguard, timeline to stable? include the A/B fallback plan and cost delta if they want guaranteed headroom.
Anita (SE): will draft and send in #customer-updates for review. also asking Nimbus for permission to run a scheduled shadow traffic test next Tue.
Maria (CS): wrap-up: replicate run tomorrow with customer oncall, confirm 95th < SLA target for 10m, then we mark mitigation as completed and update renewal risk to "monitoring". :thumbsup:
Sam (Infra): +1. I'll keep the reserve slot and autoscale logs for postmortem.
DeployBot: run/1754012890 loadtest-complete status=success max-rps=72 p95=210ms p50=48ms artifacts=/runs/1754012360/artifacts
Lee (Eng): saving artifacts and perf notes to the bringup playbook (internal link).
Maria (CS): thanks everyone — schedule invites incoming.
